summary: Shows ansible.utils.ipaddr, ipv4 and ipv6 filters for validating IP addresses and extracting the address from a CIDR.
questions: How do I check if a string is a valid IP address in Ansible?
How do I get the IP from a CIDR like 192.0.2.1/24?
How do I test for an IPv6 address in a template?

answer_card.title: IP address filters
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ myvar | ansible.utils.ipaddr }}   # valid IP?
{{ myvar | ansible.utils.ipv4 }}
{{ myvar | ansible.utils.ipv6 }}
{{ '192.0.2.1/24' | ansible.utils.ipaddr('address') }}   # 192.0.2.1
```

Requires the ansible.utils collection.
